text:
maria: Heads up — eu-west-2 GPU warm-pool joins spiking fail rate. SRE dashboards show KEYSERV decrypt backoffs and a bunch of 403s from auditshipper -> siem.redwood-sec.com after a firewall change around 09:12 UTC. Anyone who touched egress rules?
ajay: I saw PR #482 merged ~09:10 by @kevin. Looks like egress was narrowed to a couple of CIDRs. Auditshipper uses the SIEM FQDN, not the pinned CIDR.
kevin: Yep that was me, tightened outbound to reduce audit blast radius for compliance. I didn’t realize auditshipper needed the DNS-based endpoint. I can revert.
sophia: FYI fallback behavior: when auditshipper can’t reach SIEM it falls back to buffered S3 delivery, which blew up NATGW egress and saturated conntrack -> kube-probe timeouts on warm-pool nodes. That’s why GPU joins stalled.
maria: Ok plan in chat: 1) kevin revert/loosen the specific egress rule to allow siem.redwood-sec.com, 2) ajay validate connectivity from an auditshipper pod, 3) sophia scale conntrack on the NAT host + drain one warm-pool AZ to rebalance, 4) open cost ticket for NAT egress burst.
ajay: Quick test command: `curl -v https://siem.redwood-sec.com/ingest -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx"` -> currently getting 403/connection reset from firewall. After rule revert should be 200.
kevin: Reverting PR now, will post diff. Note — we should be careful: compliance wanted the tighten because of noisy logs, maybe we move auditshipper behind a private egress IP list next.
deploy-bot: Firewall-PR-482 revert deployed by kevin at 09:23 UTC (CI-ID: fw-revert-482).
sophia: Rechecking: auditshipper -> SIEM returns 200 from canary pod. Keystore decrypt errors cleared in the logs, warm-pool join rate back to nominal over last 2 mins.
maria: Monitoring 30m. Also FIN note: S3 fallback pushed ~1.2TB outbound via NAT; at ~$0.09/GB that's roughly ~$110 in unexpected egress. I opened FIN-752 and linked the raw billing spikes.
ajay: 👍 assigning follow-ups: kevin to update firewall runbook (include auditshipper allowlist by FQDN + NAT plan), sophia to add conntrack autoscale to gateway ASG, maria to attach FIN-752 to the incident doc and postmortem template.
kevin: Will add runbook entry and propose a safer rollout (canary allowlist + alert on S3 fallback).
sophia: Side note: recommend we add an early-warning alert in fleet-metrics when auditshipper 5xx/403 rate exceeds X% for >1m (prevents NAT burst fallback).
maria: Agreed. If anyone sees residual join errors ping me. Closing in this thread once monitoring window clear. :white_check_mark:
